images.alt: Two display panels side by side on a rail. The left one is an empty frame; the right holds a dense printed document. A wax seal on a cord has slid along the rail from the left panel to the right one.
images.prompt: A binding diagram, drawn calmly. Two display panels stand side by side on a low horizontal rail across the middle of the frame. The left panel is an empty frame on a plinth. The right panel holds a single dense document covered in small print and a schematic. A heavy wax seal hangs on a short cord clipped to a runner on the rail; the runner has plainly slid from the left panel to the right one, and a faint scuff line on the rail records the travel. Place both panels well inside the frame with generous empty space above and below them.

images.alt: Small square tiles pour from a hopper through a coarse sieve without catching, then land on a much finer sieve below, where about a third are held on the surface and the rest fall into a tray.
images.prompt: Two sieves stacked in a vertical column at the centre of the frame. A hopper at the top pours a crowd of small identical square tiles into the upper sieve, whose mesh is wide; every tile drops straight through without catching. The tiles land on a second sieve below with a much finer mesh, where roughly a third of them are caught and sit on the surface while the rest fall on into a shallow tray beneath. Keep the whole column well inside the frame with generous margin at top, bottom and both sides.
